rules.name: combined-var-slow-01-app-queries
rules.sql: SELECT business_unit, value_date, settlement_date FROM opera.valuation_date_table WHERE tenant_id = :tenant AND UPPER(business_unit) IN ('CFS', 'RMC')
SELECT count(*) AS n FROM (SELECT invenio_product_code, db_format_code, cont_month_format_code FROM opera.var_product_code_mapping_table WHERE tenant_id = :tenant) q

SELECT count(*) AS n FROM (SELECT underlying_id, expiry_date, invenio_product_code FROM opera.underlying_list_table WHERE tenant_id = :tenant AND underlying_id NOT ILIKE '%USD%' AND expiry_date > (SELECT settlement_date FROM opera.valuation_date_table WHERE tenant_id = :tenant AND UPPER(business_unit) = 'CFS' LIMIT 1) ORDER BY UPPER(underlying_id) COLLATE "C", underlying_id COLLATE "C") q

SELECT count(*) AS n FROM (SELECT vol_id, expiry_date, product_code AS invenio_product_code FROM opera.vol_id_table WHERE tenant_id = :tenant AND vol_id NOT ILIKE '%USD%' AND expiry_date > (SELECT settlement_date FROM opera.valuation_date_table WHERE tenant_id = :tenant AND UPPER(business_unit) = 'CFS' LIMIT 1) ORDER BY UPPER(vol_id) COLLATE "C", vol_id COLLATE "C") q

SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM opera.future_cont_series_table WHERE tenant_id = :tenant AND settlement_date = (SELECT settlement_date FROM opera.valuation_date_table WHERE tenant_id = :tenant AND UPPER(business_unit) = 'CFS' LIMIT 1)) AS future_cont_rows, (SELECT count(*) FROM opera.option_cont_series_table WHERE tenant_id = :tenant AND settlement_date = (SELECT settlement_date FROM opera.valuation_date_table WHERE tenant_id = :tenant AND UPPER(business_unit) = 'CFS' LIMIT 1)) AS option_cont_rows

SELECT count(*) AS n, sum(mtm_usd) AS s1, sum(mtm_nc) AS s2, sum(settle_delta_1) AS s3, sum(settle_vega_1) AS s4, sum(settle_theta) AS s5 FROM opera.helper_settle_pricing_subportfoliovalues_view WHERE tenant_id = :tenant AND UPPER(business_unit) = 'CFS' AND value_date = (SELECT value_date FROM opera.valuation_date_table WHERE tenant_id = :tenant AND UPPER(business_unit) = 'CFS' LIMIT 1) AND derivative_type NOT ILIKE 'fx%' AND subportfolio NOT ILIKE 'conso%'

SELECT count(*) AS n, sum(mtm_usd) AS s1, sum(mtm_nc) AS s2, sum(settle_delta_1) AS s3, sum(settle_vega_1) AS s4, sum(settle_theta) AS s5 FROM opera.helper_settle_pricing_subportfoliovalues_view WHERE tenant_id = :tenant AND UPPER(business_unit) = 'RMC' AND value_date = (SELECT value_date FROM opera.valuation_date_table WHERE tenant_id = :tenant AND UPPER(business_unit) = 'RMC' LIMIT 1) AND derivative_type NOT ILIKE 'fx%' AND subportfolio NOT ILIKE 'conso%' AND p1_name NOT ILIKE 'CM OR%'

SELECT UPPER(business_unit) AS bu, value_date, count(*) AS rows_in_table FROM opera.var_accounting_table WHERE tenant_id = :tenant AND value_date >= (SELECT min(value_date) FROM opera.valuation_date_table WHERE tenant_id = :tenant AND UPPER(business_unit) IN ('CFS', 'RMC')) GROUP BY UPPER(business_unit), value_date ORDER BY 2 DESC, 1 LIMIT 40
SELECT count(*) AS n, max(settlement_date) AS max_settle FROM opera.helper_var_accounting_report WHERE tenant_id = :tenant
